title: Ban cap nhat v1.2.4 - Fix triet de loi treo Not Responding khi click phan cung ESP32
releaseNotes:
- Xu ly bat dong bo lenh gui click ESP32 kem WriteTimeout 800ms tranh nghẽn cong COM treo ung dung
- Chuyen log ESP32 sang BeginInvoke khong bao gio gay deadlock voi luong giao dien UI
- Bo AttachThreadInput tren DeviceView tranh khoa cheo luong voi cua so SDL scrcpy
- Tu dong an ban phim ao tren may khi dien ten de nut Tiep tuc (Agree and Continue) luon hien thi ro rang
